Common.informationOnlyBody: RegShield CA provides public information and official roster lookups. It does not provide legal advice.

Verify.title: Verify
Verify.description: Check whether a person or organization appears on official rosters. We show evidence links and explain what it means.
Verify.stateHint: Organizations are filtered by state. Accredited representatives are searched nationally.
Verify.disclaimer: We do not confirm someone is authorized to represent you in all contexts. Always verify via official sources.

officialLinks.title: Official verification links (manual check)
officialLinks.calbarBody: If someone claims to be an attorney, verify their status directly with the State Bar of California.
officialLinks.sosBody: If someone claims to be an immigration consultant in California, check registration and compliance.

About.title: About
About.body: RegShield CA is a safety layer that helps people verify credentials, avoid scams, and find legal aid faster. It provides public information and official links, not legal advice.

doj.title: DOJ EOIR Recognition & Accreditation rosters
doj.body: We sync public roster PDFs so you can search recognized organizations and accredited representatives.

calbar.title: State Bar of California
calbar.body: For attorney claims, always verify directly with the State Bar.

sos.title: CA Secretary of State (Immigration Consultant Search)
sos.body: For immigration consultant claims in California, verify registration and compliance with CA SOS.

About.updatesBody: Roster data is synced daily around 06:00 America/Los_Angeles (best effort).

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.body: We design RegShield CA to minimize sensitive data collection. The evidence vault is local by default and is never uploaded unless you choose to share it outside the app.
Privacy.vaultBody: Evidence vault files are stored in your browser (IndexedDB) and encrypted with your passphrase. The passphrase is never sent to a server.
Privacy.logsBody: We avoid collecting sensitive information in logs and monitoring. Do not enter sensitive identifiers unless necessary.
Privacy.thirdPartiesBody: RegShield CA may use infrastructure providers (e.g., hosting and database) to operate the service. Evidence vault content is not uploaded by default.

Ask.title: Ask
Ask.description: AI-assisted, information-only Q&A about California immigration basics, legal aid, and credential checks.
Ask.disclaimerBody: Information only, not legal advice. Do not enter sensitive info (A-number, passport/ID, full address).
Ask.contextHint: Long chats may send only recent context.
Ask.empty: Ask a question to get started. Your chat stays on this device unless you clear it.
Ask.inputPlaceholder: Ask about immigration steps, deadlines, legal aid options, or how to verify credentials...
Ask.confirmDelete: Delete this chat from this device? This can't be undone.
Ask.tipsBody: Keep your questions general. Use official sources and verification links.
Ask.tip1: Avoid sharing sensitive personal info (A-number, passport/ID numbers, full address).
Ask.tip2: If you need legal advice for your specific case, contact a qualified attorney or accredited representative.
Ask.tip3: When in doubt, verify credentials using official directories and follow evidence links.
Ask.consentBody: I understand this is general information, not legal advice, and I should not share sensitive personal information.
Ask.errorNotConfigured: AI Q&A is not configured on this server.
Ask.errorTryAgain: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
Disclaimer.body: RegShield CA provides information and official lookup links. It is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.
Disclaimer.rosterBody: A match means a person or organization appears on an official roster entry. It does not guarantee they are authorized to represent you in every context.
Disclaimer.noAdviceBody: Nothing in this app should be interpreted as legal advice or a recommendation for a specific case strategy.
Disclaimer.emergencyBody: If you are in immediate danger, call 911.
